caption:
does chocolate cause acne?

In one small study, 25 men with acne-prone skin ate 25 g of 99% dark chocolate every day. Their acne scores were up by week two and stayed up at week four.

A second study hid pure cocoa in capsules so no one knew what they took. 13 men finished it, and lesions went up by day four.

Both studies were small and only included men, so this isn't proof for everyone. If your skin breaks out easily, try noticing what happens after a chocolate-heavy week.

Send this to the friend who says chocolate never breaks them out.

General education only. Not medical advice.

Sources:
Vongraviopap & Asawanonda, Int J Dermatol 2016. doi:10.1111/ijd.13188
Caperton et al., J Clin Aesthet Dermatol 2014. PMID 24847404
